title: Happy New Year from Little Nemo
content: In the world of Winsor McCay's Little Nemo, the world gets smaller and smaller.Little Nemo, 1908Nemo is confronted by the bearded old man representing the previous year, but the old man can't hold on. As he falls away, the baby new year makes his appearance.I'm impressed with how McCay was able to communicate the idea that the world was shrinking in the top panels, and the way he gradated the color in the background of the bottom panels.-----Book:Winsor McCay. The Complete Little Nemo 1905–1909
